page_title: ATM 3-0 VAL | Atletico Madrid v Valencia 15/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' 3 - 0 Goal! Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:0.
90+3' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Cesar Soto Grado saw the whole situation.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' The resulting corner, taken by German Valera (Valencia), comes to nothing.
87' Thierry Correia (Valencia) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom right corner, but Jan Oblak is equal to it and makes an easy save.
86' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
86' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
85' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
84' An attempted cross from German Valera (Valencia) is cleared.
82' Diego Lopez (Valencia) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
82' Sergi Canos (Valencia) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
80' Sergi Canos (Valencia) wins the ball from the resulting free kick but scuffs his shot well wide of the left post!
80' It looks like Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) saw red with that tackle. Cesar Soto Grado won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Valencia earn a free kick.
79' Ruben Baraja has decided to make a change. German Valera (Valencia) replaces Javi Guerra.
79' It is time for a substitution. Martin Tejon (Valencia) is on for Dani Gomez.
77' Post! Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) latches on to a sweet pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which only hits the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cesar Azpilicueta departs the field of play to be replaced by Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid).
76' Here is a change. Antoine Griezmann is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid).
75' Half-chance! Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) plays a pass into the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili reacts well to snuff out the attack.
74' Dani Gomez (Valencia) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
73' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Atl. Madrid.
71' The attendance for today's match is 61752.
71' Ruben Baraja has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) replacing Dimitri Foulquier.
70' Today's match ends for Luis Rioja who will be replaced by Sergi Canos (Valencia).
69' Luis Rioja (Valencia) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
68' Luis Rioja (Valencia) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
67' Diego Simeone prepares a substitution. Samuel Lino is replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid).
66' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Luis Rioja (Valencia). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

66' Pepelu (Valencia) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Valencia.
65' Valencia take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
63' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 12:2.
61' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Alexander Sorloth will be replaced by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid).
61' The substitution has been made. Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) has replaced Rodrigo de Paul.
59' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.

58' Thierry Correia (Valencia) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
56' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
56' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) steps up to send the ball in.
55' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. Atl. Madrid get a corner.
54' 2 - 0 Gooal! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) scores with a shot from inside the box after latching onto a headed pass from Samuel Lino. He makes it 2:0.
52' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) commits a rough challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for an infringement.
51' Wasted opportunity. Javi Guerra (Valencia) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
51' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Valencia, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
51' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul. Valencia have a free kick.
48' A pass into the penalty area from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted by the defence.
47' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
46' Cesar Soto Grado has a clear sight and sees a foul from Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid).
46' Half-time substitution. Ruben Baraja decided to make a change. Hugo Guillamon is replaced by Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia).
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Pepelu (Valencia) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Diego Lopez (Valencia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
42' Valencia are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

39' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid). Rodrigo de Paul plays a fantastic through ball and finds Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
36' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
35' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).
34' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atl. Madrid.
34' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

34' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Atl. Madrid are going to take it.
33' The cross fools the defence and leaves Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the right post.
32' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) for his blatant foul.
32' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
30' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Samuel Lino, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
30' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
29' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid win a corner kick.
27' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
25' The free kick from long range, taken by Valencia, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
25' Koke (Atl. Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.
23' Handball by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid).
22' Atl. Madrid enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
20' A cross into the box picks out Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the right post.
20' Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off a great save to deny Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
19' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
18' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Atl. Madrid manage to earn a corner.
17' 76:24 – the latest ball possession ratio.

14' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the right post.

11' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.
10' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) was quite harsh and Cesar Soto Grado didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
9' A lofted cross from Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
8' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
8' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
6' Dani Gomez (Valencia) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
4' Pepelu (Valencia) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.

3' Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul after Koke (Atl. Madrid) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. It's a free kick to Valencia, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
2' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
2' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' One of the players from Valencia times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' The match has just started.
